senses.gloss: (b. h.) neck, esp. the front of the neck, throat, opp. עוֹרֶף.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 30a:4">Ab. Zar. 30ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>עלי ועל צַוָּארִי</he> upon me and my throat, i.e. I take the responsibility.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:3:3">Y. Snh. VI, 23ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>דמו תלוי בצַוַּאר עדים</he> his blood be suspended from the neck of the witnesses, i.e. they will have to answer for the innocent blood; Bab.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 44b:11">Snh. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>ויהא קולר תלוי בצ׳ עדים</he>, v. <cite ref="S00366"><he>קוֹלָר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:8">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> <he>צַוָּארֵךְ זה בית וכ׳</he> ‘thy neck’ (<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:8">ib.</cite>) means the Temple; <he>שכל הימים … היה צַוָּארָן … פשוט וכ׳</he> for as long as the Temple stood, Israel’s neck was stretched (uplifted) among the nations &c.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 5:5">Lam. R. to V, 5</cite> [read:] <he>על שבגדנו בצַוָּארֵנוּ בא יום צרה</he> because we were faithless to our ‘neck’ (the Temple), the day of distress came; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Shabbat 90b:3">Sabb. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>צַוָּארֵי דקל</he> Ms. M., v. <cite ref="R00243"><he>צוּר</he> III</cite>.]
